notes: PLUMBING RUN. The generator is a deterministic fake; nothing here measures model quality.
Answer accuracy is graded by phrase rules in the benchmark (must_include / must_not_include), not by a model: it is transparent but coarse.
HCER threshold: confidence >= 0.8. Confidence is verification-derived for verified_rag and model-stated for the other arms, so HCER compares two different kinds of confidence.
The authority-verification probes were written together with the checks: AVA is a regression suite over constructed cases, not a held-out estimate.
Document and case names in this corpus are synthetic fixtures, not real Indian law.
The audit judge is lexical word-overlap, which cannot detect a contradiction: EGA/UCR/CSR are approximate. See the audit-judge check below.
